methodology: A calendar day is FREE only if ZERO games from all monitored leagues are on AM/FM radio that day (including Westwood One national). Radio window includes pregame (30-60 min). We compute longest consecutive FREE stretches per calendar year. 2026 is verified; 2027-2029 are ESTIMATED based on historical scheduling patterns and flagged accordingly.

2026_verified.label: Post-Super Bowl window #1
2026_verified.note: Super Bowl Feb 8. Next busy is MLB spring training reporting ~Feb 20. True free window. Verified.

2026_verified.label: Pre-spring training #2
2026_verified.note: Spring training games start Feb 24 (Cactus/Grapefruit). Still free. Verified via MLB spring training schedule.

2026_verified.label: BEST 2-week vacation 2026
2026_verified.note: Only 14+ consecutive free days in 2026. No MLB, NFL, NCAAF, WW. Ideal.

2026_verified.label: No 21-day window in 2026
2026_verified.note: Longest free is 14 days; 21-day impossible due to spring training start Feb 24 and NFL playoffs Jan + MLB Oct. MLB postseason through Oct 31 + NFL from Sep 10 creates continuous busy.

2026_verified.label: MLB All-Star break mini-window
2026_verified.note: Only gap during MLB season. Not enough for week vacation. No NFL/NCAAF then, but still only 3 days.

2027_estimated.note: ESTIMATED: Super Bowl LXI expected Feb 7 2027 at SoFi Stadium (awarded). Verify when NFL releases 2026 schedule May 2026. Treated as estimate.

2027_estimated.label: BEST 2-week 2027 (est)
2027_estimated.note: ESTIMATED: Pre-spring training. If MLB Opening Day late March (expected Mar 25 2027), this remains free. Flagged as estimate.

2027_estimated.label: No 21-day window (est)
2027_estimated.note: Same constraint as 2026. 21 free days unlikely; would require skipping spring training which is defined as busy.

2028_estimated.note: ESTIMATED: Super Bowl 2028 location TBD, date ~Feb 6. Verify when released.

2028_estimated.label: BEST 2-week 2028 (est)
2028_estimated.note: ESTIMATED: Pre-spring training. 2028 is leap year; MLB Opening Day expected Mar 30 2028 (after Olympics? Actually Summer Olympics 2028 Jul 14-30 in LA may shift MLB All-Star break). Still free Feb window.

2028_estimated.label: No 21-day window (est)
2028_estimated.note: ESTIMATED. Plus 2028 LA Olympics may create additional busy (not in scope) but not AM/FM per current definition.

2029_estimated.label: BEST 2-week 2029 (est)
2029_estimated.note: ESTIMATED: Pre-spring training. MLB Opening Day expected Mar 29 2029.

conclusion: Only reliable vacation windows are the 2 weeks immediately after the Super Bowl in early February each year (Feb 9-22 in 2026, similar in 2027-2029). No 3-week fully-free window exists under your definition (all MLB + NFL + NCAAF + Westwood One). If you relax to ignore MLB spring training (preseason), you gain ~5 weeks (Feb 9 to Mar 24). See methodology page.
